title: Request-isolated synthetic verified-principal binding adapter
prerequisites: Owner authorizes exact two implementation files and synthetic scope
Allocate new unique Task and commit/validate immutable ContextPack before code
Recheck then-current main and preserve accepted Task52 contract and Auth architecture
supporting_paths: New task/pack/EB/inputs, report/evidence and PR manifest only; no existing production file changes

design_proposal.lifetime: One immutable provider closure per request; no singleton actor/token state or mutable global request slot
design_proposal.injected_verifier: Trusted synthetic verificationPort.verify(exactToken) returns verified userId plus verified claims sub/session_id/exp and verification time from same-token verification. No caller-supplied identity; correlation with that exact request token is explicit at seam.
design_proposal.validation: Fail closed on absent/error/malformed proof, subject disagreement, invalid UUID/session, expired/future/stale evidence and nonfinite values; return immutable VerifiedPrincipal compatible with existing checkedPrincipal
design_proposal.limits: This is binding and validation of injected verification responses only, not JWT cryptography/getClaims/getUser integration or real session validation. The production verifier API remains OWNER_DECISION_PENDING; arbitrary JSON does not authenticate a user.

acceptance.requirement: Valid injected same-token user/claims produces immutable principal under existing types/freshness policy
Missing token or verification failure/errors/malformed response denies; no decoded token fallback
Verified userId must equal verified claims subject; invalid/missing session id denies
Expired token, stale/future verifiedAt and invalid/nonfinite timestamps deny without relaxing existing checkedPrincipal
Concurrent and out-of-order requests for two authors remain isolated; verifier receives only its own immutable request token
Token switch/mismatched verification correlation denies; refresh creates a new request-scoped provider, never mutates another
Post-async verification rechecks time and identity; caller cannot mutate returned principal or influence another request
Unit tests use injected synthetic verification responses and clock only, no network/database/environment credentials/JWT signing
No module registration/controller/route/pool/SQL/managed-session privileges/real Auth implementation; no dependency or CI changes
Existing12focused/32PG and all applicable governance/security/recovery gates remain unchanged; distinct review and separate owner feature merge

commands: Existing applicable ready-state CI including unchanged32-case disposable PG17 runner
forbidden: Hosted queries/credentials/real Auth users/live JWT probes
Real session UPDATE/lock grants and production credential provisioning
